production.note: US model years. First: Chevrolet's 2014 SS brochure. Last: The Drive (Max Goldberg, 17 February 2017): "the Chevrolet SS was ending production after the 2017 model year" (thedrive-2017-ss-final-year); no opened Chevrolet page states the end year.

displacementL.note: Chevrolet's brochure gives litres only ('6.2L'); no cc figure was found on an opened page.

aspiration.note: Inferred from the brochure's description of the LS3 V8 (no forced induction mentioned).

fuel.note: Inferred from the brochure's description of the petrol LS3 V8 ('SFI').

transmission.note: 'the 2015 SS can be had with either a six-speed auto or, new for this year, a six-speed manual.' (The Truth About Cars, Cameron Aubernon, 27 November 2014). The 2014 car had only the automatic: '6-speed automatic with TAPshift manual shift control' (chevrolet-2014-ss-brochure).

powerHp.note: 2014 launch rating. Quote: "6.2L V8 SFI (LS3) with 415 hp @ 5900 rpm and 415 lb.-ft. of torque @ 4600 rpm".

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL: one named-author article, one unsigned article and three databases, all agreeing. 2014 SS sedan with the 6-speed automatic (the only transmission for 2014; the manual came for 2015). Mark Maynard (Creators Syndicate, 18 February 2014): "3,975 pounds". Yahoo Autos Motoramic, no author named: "3,975 lbs." (yahoo-motoramic-2014-ss). Databases: Edmunds "Curb weight | 3,975 lbs." (edmunds-ss-2014-specs), Cars.com "Base Curb Weight 3,975 lbs" (cars-com-ss-2014-specs), KBB "3,975 pounds" (kbb-ss-2014-specs). Chevrolet's brochure gives no curb weight.

provisionalNote: Weight is provisional: 3,975 lb for the 2014 automatic sedan rests on one named-author article (Mark Maynard, Creators Syndicate), an unsigned Yahoo Motoramic review and three databases (Edmunds, Cars.com, KBB), all agreeing. A Chevrolet specification sheet (media.chevrolet.com, which refuses the research tools) or a Car and Driver, Road & Track or MotorTrend spec panel for a 2014 SS would replace it. The end year (2017) and the 2015 manual rest on editorial articles, not Chevrolet pages.
